# tsuga_operation_api_key (Resource)

An operation API key used to authenticate API, Terraform, MCP, and Tsuga CLI clients.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "time_offset" "example" {
  offset_days = 30
}

resource "tsuga_operation_api_key" "example" {
  name       = "terraform-production"
  owner      = "abc-123-def"
  scope      = "owning-team-only"
  expires_at = time_offset.example.rfc3339

  permissions = {
    dashboard = "write"
    monitor   = "write"
    logs      = "read"
  }

  tags = [
    {
      key   = "env"
      value = "prod"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `expires_at` (String) Date and time after which the key stops working. When the caller is an operation API key, set a future expiration, no later than the caller's own when the caller expires.
- `name` (String) Kebab-case name for the operation API key.
- `owner` (String) ID of the team that owns the operation API key. When the caller is an operation API key, the team must be within the caller's scope.
- `permissions` (Map of String) Resource types the key can act on, each mapped to `read` or `write`. `write` also grants read access. A resource type absent from the map is not accessible to the key at all. Keys are API resource types such as `dashboard`, `dashboard-folder` or `logs`.
- `scope` (String) Team-access boundary for the operation API key. Set when the key is created or updated. `all` can reach all teams, `owning-team-and-public` can reach the owning team and public teams, and `owning-team-only` can reach only the owning team.

### Optional

- `tags` (Attributes List) Key/value tags to apply to the resource. Tag policies may require specific keys or values. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the operation API key. Generated by Tsuga when the key is created. Use this as the stable key identifier when correlating API calls with audit logs or key-management records.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) The full API key value. Only available at creation time; not retrievable afterwards.
- `key_last_characters` (String) Last characters of the operation API key secret. Set by Tsuga from the generated secret and returned because the full secret is only shown once at creation. Use this to distinguish saved keys without exposing the secret.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Required:

- `key` (String) Tag key to attach to the resource.
- `value` (String) Tag value to attach to the resource. Leading or trailing whitespace is rejected.
